tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The window's own background, visible between the colour planes.

tokens.name: ground-ink
tokens.usage: Text directly on ground: the title bar, the legend under the data bar.

tokens.name: ground-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on ground. 7.3:1 light, 7.8:1 dark.

tokens.name: plane-1
tokens.usage: The lower colour plane: the status readout and every expander.

tokens.name: plane-1-ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on plane-1. 18.9:1 light, 13.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: plane-1-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on plane-1. 6.6:1 light, 7.0:1 dark.

tokens.name: plane-1-hair
tokens.usage: Hairline rules inside plane-1. Decorative: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: plane-2
tokens.usage: The upper colour plane, overlapping plane-1: the count and the apply button. Inverts between themes so the layering reads the same way in both.

tokens.name: plane-2-ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on plane-2. 17.6:1 light, 17.0:1 dark.

tokens.name: plane-2-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on plane-2. 7.6:1 light, 6.0:1 dark.

tokens.name: plane-2-hair
tokens.usage: Hairline rules inside plane-2.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: The one accent. Iron-oxide red, the same in both themes. Once per view.

tokens.name: red-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of red surfaces, and the progress band over them.

tokens.name: red-ink
tokens.usage: The accent as text on ground and plane-1. 5.1:1 light, 6.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: on-red
tokens.usage: Text and icons on red and red-deep. 5.5:1.

tokens.name: seg-off
tokens.usage: An unlit segment of the 68-policy data bar, and an empty progress track.

tokens.name: seg-on
tokens.usage: A lit segment: one of the 40 gains.

tokens.name: held
tokens.usage: The hatching over the 7 losses. Never carries meaning on its own.

tokens.name: hover-1
tokens.usage: Hover wash on ground and plane-1. Alpha hex: 5% ink.

tokens.name: hover-2
tokens.usage: Hover wash on plane-2.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px keyboard focus ring, offset 2px. Plain ink, never the accent.

tokens.name: close-hover
tokens.usage: Fill behind the title bar's close button on hover.

tokens.name: scroll-thumb
tokens.usage: The scroll thumb at rest. Alpha hex: 35% ink, so it reads on both the ground and a colour plane without a track behind it.

tokens.name: scroll-thumb-hover
tokens.usage: The scroll thumb while hovered or dragged. 65% ink.

families.display: Arial, Microsoft JhengHei UI, Microsoft YaHei UI
families.sans: Arial, Microsoft JhengHei UI, Microsoft YaHei UI

tokens.name: grid-margin
tokens.usage: Left and right margin of the 12-column grid.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Gap between grid columns, and between the three parts of the data bar.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a title and the text under it.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inside a colour plane, from its edge to its content.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between the data bar and the expanders.

tokens.name: plane-overlap
tokens.usage: How far plane-2 travels left when the superset is applied: one column plus a gutter.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything. There is no rounded corner anywhere in this system.

tokens.name: titlebar
tokens.usage: The custom title bar. The native Windows frame is never used.

tokens.name: window-button
tokens.usage: Width of a minimise/maximise/close button.

tokens.name: action-height
tokens.usage: The apply button.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: A readout row.

tokens.name: section-head
tokens.usage: An expander's header.

tokens.name: choice-row
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a tickable row.

tokens.name: checkbox
tokens.usage: The tick box. Even, so a 1px edge lands on whole pixels at every scale.

tokens.name: checkbox-stroke
tokens.usage: The tick box's inset stroke. Identical ticked and unticked, so ticking never shifts the row.

tokens.name: segment
tokens.usage: Height of one of the 68 segments in the data bar.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: The progress band along the bottom of plane-2.

tokens.name: scrollbar
tokens.usage: Width of the scroll strip at the window's right edge. No arrows, no track.

tokens.name: scroll-thumb0
tokens.usage: Width of the thumb inside that strip, right-aligned.

tokens.name: scroll-thumb-min
tokens.usage: Shortest the thumb gets, so it stays grabbable on a very long page.

tokens.name: window-min-width
tokens.usage: The 12-column grid stops making sense below this.

tokens.name: window-min-height
tokens.usage: Below this the status readout and the apply button cannot both be seen.

tokens.name: window-default-height
tokens.usage: The height a fresh launch opens at: enough for the whole collapsed page plus the title bar, so nobody meets a scroll bar before they have read anything.

tokens.name: plane-travel
tokens.usage: plane-2 sliding one column left as the superset takes effect.

tokens.name: count
tokens.usage: The count ticking up from 0 to the number of gains.

tokens.name: wipe
tokens.usage: A readout value replacing its old text, revealed left to right.

tokens.name: segment-fade
tokens.usage: One segment lighting. Named apart from the `segment` size token: every token name has to be unique across families.

tokens.name: segment-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between consecutive segments along the bar.

tokens.name: expand
tokens.usage: An expander opening or closing.

tokens.name: press
tokens.usage: Hover and press feedback.
